context: Tests whether the agent correctly detects a hexagonal multi-module Maven backend and implements a new feature (Guest, UC-020) by imitating the existing RoomType exemplar's exact conventions, rather than inventing a flat structure or 'fixing' the asymmetric hexagonal pattern into textbook full hexagonal. This is the single highest-risk behavior of the aiup-angular-jpa plugin's implement skill.

checklist.name: Pure domain record with zero framework imports
checklist.description: A Guest record is created in hotel-domain (package com.example.hotel.domain.guest or similar), using only @Builder (Lombok) with no JPA, Spring, or persistence imports anywhere in the class

checklist.name: No JPA/Spring leakage into hotel-domain
checklist.description: Nothing added to the hotel-domain module contains @Entity, @Service, @Repository, @RestController, or any javax/jakarta.persistence or org.springframework import

checklist.name: Outbound port as plain sibling interface, not a port subpackage
checklist.description: A GuestRepository interface is created directly in the business-module guest package (e.g. com.example.hotel.business.guest), matching where RoomTypeRepository sits — NOT in a business.guest.port or business.port.out subpackage

checklist.name: No inbound port/use-case interface invented
checklist.description: No new interface is created for the controller to depend on (e.g. no GuestUseCase, no GuestServicePort, no inbound port of any kind) — none exists anywhere in the reactor for RoomType either

checklist.name: Controller depends on the concrete service
checklist.description: GuestController in hotel-api directly autowires/injects the concrete GuestService class (not an interface), matching RoomTypeController's dependency on the concrete RoomTypeService

checklist.name: DTO factory method on the DTO record itself
checklist.description: GuestDTO is a record with a static fromBusiness(Guest) method converting from the domain type, matching RoomTypeDTO's exact pattern — not a separate mapper class for this conversion

checklist.name: Hand-written static converters, not MapStruct
checklist.description: GuestConverter (entity->domain) and GuestEntityConverter (domain->entity) are hand-written static-method classes in postgres.guest.converter, matching RoomTypeConverter/RoomTypeEntityConverter — no MapStruct annotations or generated mapper interfaces introduced

checklist.name: Separate JPA entity from the domain record
checklist.description: GuestEntity is a distinct @Entity class in hotel-postgres (postgres.guest.model package), not a reuse or annotation of the domain Guest record

checklist.name: Spring Data repository + port implementation in hotel-postgres
checklist.description: A GuestJpaRepository extends JpaRepository<GuestEntity, Long> in postgres.guest.query, and a GuestRepositoryImpl in postgres.guest implements the business module's GuestRepository port

checklist.name: Flyway migration placed in the persistence-adapter module
checklist.description: The new migration (e.g. V2__create_guest.sql) is placed under hotel-postgres/src/main/resources/db/migration — not under hotel-app, hotel-api, or a generic top-level backend/ path

checklist.name: Email uniqueness enforced at the database level
checklist.description: The Guest table migration includes a UNIQUE constraint on the email column, matching BR-020

checklist.name: Correct module for each new file
checklist.description: Every new file is placed in the module matching its architectural role (domain record in hotel-domain, service/port/DTO in hotel-business, entity/converters/JPA repo/port-impl/migration in hotel-postgres, controller in hotel-api) — no file crosses into the wrong module

checklist.name: No test files created
checklist.description: No test classes are created as part of this task
